texts: When a week is a high-wraith week, two Keepers tend the Stilllight Lantern together.

fields.sentence: When a week is a high-wraith week, two Keepers tend the Stilllight Lantern together.

q2_gaps: bare "when P, Q" whose trigger clause P is copular/stative ("a week is a high-wraith week"): the whenever machinery ties the per-occurrence Skolem response to its trigger with `During`, but a copular trigger reifies no eventuality to fill `During`'s second slot, and `During` is otherwise restricted to nesting one eventuality inside another (and to the words during/while/throughout)
review.notes: `During` here takes the week entity `$w` rather than an eventuality, which is the gap above. `Patient` for "tend" is borderline against the does-the-object-change test, whose stated tiebreak is `Theme`.
